scope: Implementation and rendering of domain-specific review articles, six-dimension coverage, historical anchors, search projection, SVG bindings and live verification. No primary-source or substantive literature approval.

checked.name: variable-section-count and coverage
checked.detail: All 10 current directions use structureVersion 2 and pass reviewStructureErrors with 5, 6 or 7 sections. An explicit 5-section fixture passes; removing all outlook coverage fails.

checked.name: historical anchor registry
checked.detail: Every config/review-anchors.json entry exactly matches the 6 section IDs, 6 title IDs and 4 question/takeaway IDs rendered by HEAD. Current historical IDs resolve; collision and missing-target fixtures fail.

checked.name: browser desktop and mobile
checked.detail: Chrome at 1440x1000 and 390x1000 for /reviews/3d-reconstruction/: 7 sections, no duplicate DOM IDs, no page overflow, SVG natural dimensions 720x840; mobile tables scroll within 358px containers. Actual figure labels/captions and first table were visually inspected.

checked.name: legacy hash and references
checked.detail: Fresh navigation to #taxonomy reaches time-models at 112px/116px viewport top. Clicking a body citation opens the bibliography and scrolls the referenced item into view after smooth scrolling.

checked.name: search reachability
checked.detail: Query 高斯怎样表示运动 returns exactly the new 3D reconstruction review at desktop and 390px; selecting it reaches /reviews/3d-reconstruction/. Search projection includes every current section title and cited reference title.

checked.name: legacy rendering compatibility
checked.detail: Before security content migration during this audit, the unchanged HEAD legacy security page rendered six sections, five questions, five takeaways, section theses and no duplicate IDs.

checked.name: figure byte binding
checked.detail: SHA-256 is computed from actual SVG bytes; the review fingerprint includes declared figure hash metadata. The dimensions predicate is too broad, as recorded in R1.

checked.name: live artifact SVG verification
checked.detail: A synthetic artifact hosted under /paper-digest/ discovers assets/reviews/sample.svg and verifies 10 resources including decoded JSON/gzip equality. Mutating only fetched SVG bytes fails with Live verification failed: assets/reviews/sample.svg: Does not match deployed artifact.

checked.name: print inspection
checked.detail: A4 Chrome print export has 32 pages. Pages 1-4 were rendered and visually inspected, including figure, table continuation and formula. No clipped figure/table/formula was found in these pages, but persistent left sidebar space reduces usable width (R2).

findings.title: Read dimensions from the root SVG element
findings.detail: The validator accepts expected width/height anywhere in the SVG string. gaussian-time-models.svg repeats width="720" height="840" on the background rect. Changing only the root to 1440x1680 while recomputing figure.sha256 leaves the current dimension predicate true even though figure.width/height metadata still claims 720x840.
findings.recommendation: Parse or tightly match the root svg tag and compare its intrinsic width/height; check viewBox consistency if required.

findings.title: Print layout retains hidden sidebar space
findings.detail: A4 output has roughly 37% left blank width on sampled pages. Sidebar/TOC are hidden but the Fumadocs parent grid still reserves a sidebar track. This pre-existed the shown CSS changes and is not classified as a v2 structure regression.
findings.recommendation: Collapse the notebook grid to one content column under print media and recheck figure/table pagination.

notChecked: Full npm test, npm run validate and production build are being run by the parent; their final results were not yet supplied.
Production preview, final commit, GitHub Pages deployment and real live-site artifact verification were not performed by this reviewer.
Primary sources and the substantive claims of the ten rewritten articles are outside this implementation review.
The full 32-page print export was not visually inspected; only pages 1-4 and print-media DOM properties were checked.
After all ten articles were migrated, structural/anchor checks were rerun; browser content inspection remained the 3D reconstruction sample plus earlier legacy security page.

collisionErrors: invalid or duplicate legacy anchor: scene-models
